verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is downloadable at https://docs.steel.dev/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key). It is backed by documented API reference sections for Sessions, Captchas, Credentials and Files, and a community comment praises the API reference. Missing for 10: first-party docs that explicitly point users to the spec download, and evidence on how complete the spec's coverage is.
